speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation; since you are a newborn, I will be speaking with your parents or guardian about your health. To begin, how old is the baby in days or weeks, and have you noticed any fever, lethargy, or poor feeding recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (Pending confirmation of clinical signs like jaundice, temperature instability, or respiratory distress).

Given the lack of prenatal care and unknown immunization status, I need to know if the baby shows any signs of infection such as fever, jaundice, poor feeding, or breathing difficulties. Please also confirm if any umbilical cord infections or skin lesions are present.

REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential, Blood Culture, and CRP. REQUEST IMAGES: Physical exam photos of umbilicus and skin.
